promise.text: Debt snowball vs avalanche: choose a payment order

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "debt", "snowball", "avalanche"

lines.text: Compare smallest-balance and highest-rate repayment using the same payment budget, while keeping essentials and every required minimum covered.

items.text: List each current balance, APR, required minimum and due date from the statement.
Record promotional end dates, deferred-interest terms, fees and any prepayment restrictions.
Set aside essential living costs and decide what extra amount is genuinely available.
Check that every required minimum is covered before directing extra money anywhere.
Choose a target order and write down the reason so you can review it later.
After each payment, check that it posted and update the account balance.

line.text: The payoff plan runs both on your own balances, rates and minimums and says which costs less in interest, with the month you would be debt-free either way.
